learning.title: Keep verification lock ownership and database roles explicit
learning.trigger: An owned check waits without test activity, or fixture allocation fails with permission denied to create database (SQLSTATE 42501).
learning.rule: Acquire the shared verification lock exactly once. A Python driver that calls fcntl.flock must run directly, not inside an outer flock command. The child inherits the outer lock descriptor; opening the same path again can block against its own inherited lock. Check the blocker PID, parent relationship, lock descriptors and command manifest before treating inactivity as a slow test or provider failure.

Keep DATABASE_URL, BAKERY_APP_DATABASE_URL and BAKERY_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL distinct according to readTestDatabaseConfig. Fixtures that allocate databases need the owned administrative connection; ordinary owner or application SQL success does not prove that capability. Preserve the resolved administrative URL across later environment merges. Never grant broader permissions to an application role to repair a test launcher.

For an owned container with dynamic port allocation, derive the actual loopback mapping after startup and update only the child process environment. Prove readiness, authenticated SQL for each required role, administrative allocation capability and wrong-password rejection without printing credentials. Rootless dynamic allocation can race before the bind; retry that exact address-in-use startup failure a bounded number of times, tearing down only the owned project and volumes between attempts. Do not reuse a stale saved port or change another stack.

A shared resource-name prefix identifies inventory, not ownership. Snapshot matching resources and their relevant inactive state before launch, require no active matching process or conflicting Docker project, and let the harness allocate a fresh UUID. Clean up only the exact UUID-bound resources proven by that harness report or log. Preserve unproven prior resources, then verify their paths and inactive state are unchanged after the run.

A noninteractive same-user systemd scope must receive an explicit user-bus environment. Verify the current UID owns its runtime directory and bus socket, then set XDG_RUNTIME_DIR to that directory and DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS to its unix bus path. Do not switch to root, a machine transport or a different daemon to compensate for missing launcher environment.

verification.requirement: Inspect individual command exits and the manifest verdict. A wrapper that catches a failed test may exit zero; that is not a test pass.

Preserve failed and interrupted attempts. Corrected drivers use new output roots. Attribute inherited gates to their actual execution and verify unchanged source hashes; never hardcode them as newly executed.

Terminate a blocked check only after proving exact task ownership and the deadlock, and checking whether tests or services have started. Preserve the before-state, release only that process, verify lock release and hand control back to the single writer.

learning.boundary: These are launcher corrections, not permission to weaken product assertions, skip independent review, change production roles, bypass a lock, stop unrelated work or relabel a fixture failure as successful behavioral evidence.
